purpose: Represent evidence-backed relationships among people or organisations, properties, interests and material events across time without treating graph connectivity as proof.
core_principle: PARTY ↔ ROLE ↔ INTEREST ↔ PROPERTY ↔ EVENT ↔ DATE ↔ EVIDENCE
rules: Graph connectivity is not proof of legal relationship.
Every material relationship must retain evidence and property/date matching.
A party to a document is not automatically the holder of a property interest.
Current relationships must not be projected backward without historical evidence.
A relationship may begin or end at a defined date and must not be treated as timeless.
Different relationship types between the same parties and property remain separate.
Unresolved identity or property matching blocks definitive relationship publication.
Private or unnecessary personal data must not be exposed in public graph views.
hard_stops: Never infer a legal relationship from graph proximity alone.
Never merge people or organisations solely by name.
Never merge distinct properties solely by address.
Never infer ownership from a party relationship.
Never expose restricted personal information merely because it exists in the graph.
